# Inven

> > Inven is an AI-powered company intelligence platform that helps dealmakers find acquisition targets, investors, and private market opportunities across 28M+ businesses.

Inven leverages advanced NLP and machine learning to extract and organize company data, enabling professionals in private equity, venture capital, investment banking, and corporate development to source deals faster and make data-driven decisions. The platform combines company search, financial data, contact information, and intent signals in a unified workspace.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered search
- Deal sourcing
- M&A intelligence
- Company search
- Acquisition targets
- Investor search
- Contact data
- Financial data
- Intent signals
- Private equity
- Venture capital
- Investment banking
- Market intelligence
- CRM integrations
- NLP technology

## Core Features

- [Company Search](https://www.inven.ai/features/company-search): Search and analyze 28M+ businesses with AI-powered filters and natural language processing.
- [Investor Search](https://www.inven.ai/features/investor-search): Find and filter investors, buyers, and build targeted lists of decision makers.
- [Deal Search](https://www.inven.ai/features/deal-search): Access private market deal data and uncover transaction insights effortlessly.
- [Financial Data](https://www.inven.ai/features/financial-data): Access public and private company financials and valuation data in one platform.
- [Contact Data](https://www.inven.ai/features/contact-data): Connect with 430M+ verified business contacts including CEOs, founders, and M&A leaders.
- [Intent to Sell Signals](https://www.inven.ai/features/intent-to-sell-signals): Identify off-market deals and companies showing intent to sell.
- [Company Alerts](https://www.inven.ai/features/company-alerts): Stay ahead with real-time monitoring of company updates and M&A activity.

## Industry Solutions

- [Private Equity](https://www.inven.ai/solutions/private-equity): Find synergistic acquisition targets and source deals for PE portfolios.
- [Venture Capital](https://www.inven.ai/solutions/venture-capital): Discover promising startups and source your next investment opportunity.
- [Corporate Development](https://www.inven.ai/solutions/corporate-development): Identify acquisition targets, analyze competitors, and accelerate M&A processes.
- [Investment Banking](https://www.inven.ai/solutions/investment-banking): Source deals 10x faster and identify targets for your clients.
- [Consulting](https://www.inven.ai/solutions/consulting): Access market intelligence, competitor analysis, and industry research.
- [Business Brokers](https://www.inven.ai/solutions/business-brokers): Source deals and connect with sellers ready to transact.

## Integrations & Tools

- [CRM Integrations](https://www.inven.ai/features/crm-integrations): Streamline workflows with integrations for HubSpot, Salesforce, Affinity, and more.
- [Chrome Extension](https://www.inven.ai/features/chrome-extension): Instantly access company data while browsing the web.
